## Scope

The `src/app` folder is the Conduit (RealWorld) Angular application shell. It wires the root `AppComponent`, `app.routes.ts`, and `app.config.ts` to three areas: [core/](core/AGENTS.md) (auth, interceptors, layout, models), [features/](features/AGENTS.md) (article, profile, settings), and `shared/` (components and pipes). Login, register, JWT, guards, and HTTP live under **core**; product routes and pages live under **features**. The SPA must align with `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md` (routes, DOM, `jwtToken`, `window.__conduit_debug__`). Parent map: [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

## Components

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| core/auth | `core/auth` | Login and register UI, `JwtService`, `UserService`, route guards | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/interceptors | `core/interceptors` | API base URL, `Token` header, errors and 401 | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/layout | `core/layout` | `nav.navbar` header and footer shell | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/models | `core/models` | `Errors`, `LoadingState` | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| features/article | `features/article` | Home, tag feed, editor, article detail | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| features/profile | `features/profile` | `/profile/:username`, favorites child routes | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| features/settings | `features/settings` | Settings form, `PUT /user`, logout | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| shared/components | `shared/components` | `app-list-errors` → `.error-messages` | — |
| shared/pipes | `shared/pipes` | `defaultImage` for null profile images | — |

**core/AGENTS.md** covers auth versus interceptors versus layout. **features/AGENTS.md** covers article, profile, and settings routes and UI. **shared** has no local `AGENTS.md`; import its symbols from core and features as existing files do.

## Routing and feature ownership

`app.routes.ts` lazy-loads components and applies guards:

| Route | Owner | Guard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `''`, `tag/:tag` | `features/article` (home) | — |
| `login`, `register` | `core/auth` | Guest only |
| `settings` | `features/settings` | `requireAuth` |
| `editor`, `editor/:slug` | `features/article` | `requireAuth` |
| `profile` (lazy) | `features/profile` | — |
| `article/:slug` | `features/article` | — |

Shell in `app.component.html`: `app-layout-header`, `router-outlet`, `app-layout-footer`.

## Rules that apply

Follow [../../RULES.md](../../RULES.md): harness-only agent edits unless tasked on application code; standalone components, `OnPush`, lazy `loadComponent` where routes already do; form `name` attributes and CSS classes per `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Domain: [../../DOMAIN.md](../../DOMAIN.md). Repository entry: [../../AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

## Local conventions

- **Shell**: Header, outlet, footer order in `app.component.html`.
- **Token**: `JwtService` uses `localStorage['jwtToken']`; `tokenInterceptor` sends `Authorization: Token <jwt>`.
- **Debug**: `app.config.ts` exposes `window.__conduit_debug__` for Playwright when `BROWSER_API` is enabled.
- **Auth startup**: `initAuth` validates via `GET /user`; 4XX → `purgeAuth`; 5XX → `unavailable` with retry in `UserService`.
- **Errors**: `app-list-errors` renders `.error-messages`; mid-session 401 via `errorInterceptor`.
- **Null images**: `defaultImage` pipe in header and profile UI; match null-field E2E expectations.
- **Vitest**: Place colocated `*.spec.ts` next to the unit under test inside `src/app` (same folder as the `.ts` component, service, or pipe). Run the full unit suite with `bun run test` (documented). For a single file, use the focused Vitest invocation described in [../../TESTING.md](../../TESTING.md) and [../../GUIDELINES.md](../../GUIDELINES.md). Do not put Playwright specs here; E2E lives under `realworld/specs/e2e/`.

System map: [../../ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Check a change

| Change type | Narrowest check |
| --- | --- |
| Service, interceptor, pipe, or component in `src/app` | `bun run test` (documented); single-file Vitest per [../../TESTING.md](../../TESTING.md). |
| Routes, templates, or selectors | `bun run test:e2e` (documented) or [run-focused-e2e-spec](../../skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Auth | [add-e2e-auth-flow-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md), [add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Article editor or detail | [add-e2e-article-crud-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Null profile fields | [add-e2e-null-fields-spec](../../realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md). |
| Production bundle | `bun run build` (documented in [../../TESTING.md](../../TESTING.md)). |
